name: Bronze
note: Early wins for the first couple of weeks.

goals.title: Survive the first week
goals.description: Keep the group going through the first seven in-game days. Deaths happen, but everyone needs to be back in the game when the week is up.

goals.title: Open the roadside museum
goals.description: Build a museum where we display the things worth remembering, from rare finds to pieces of server history. Once it's open, every survivor can donate exhibits.

subtasks.label: Pick a spot on the highway

goals.title: Everyone reaches level 10 in a skill
goals.description: Every survivor picks a skill and takes it all the way to level 10. Done once all eight have one.

goals.title: Hold the fishing competition
goals.description: A server-wide fishing contest. The heaviest fish wins, and a trophy-size catch wins on the spot.

name: Silver
note: Group projects once the base is stable.

goals.title: Clear the prison
goals.description: Clear every building of zombies. No zomboid left standing (or crawling).

goals.title: Take a road trip together
goals.description: All eight survivors head out together, travel somewhere far from home and make it back. Where we go doesn't matter, the trip is the goal.

goals.title: Night raid
goals.description: Pick a big location and clear it as a group, after dark. Done when the place is empty before the sun comes up.

goals.title: Survive the first winter
goals.description: Get the whole group through the cold months, from the first frost until spring.

goals.title: Keep every farm animal
goals.description: Raise one of each farm animal at the same time: a cow, a pig, a sheep, a chicken, a turkey and a rabbit.

goals.title: Build a cemetery for the fallen
goals.description: Build a place to remember the survivors we lost. Done once the first grave or memorial is in place.

goals.title: Clear a Louisville skyscraper
goals.description: Clear one of Louisville's skyscrapers, from the lobby to the roof. That's up to 32 floors of zombies.

goals.title: Survive a full year
goals.description: Keep the server going for a full in-game year from the day we started.

goals.title: Collect all 120 skill books
goals.description: Find all five volumes for each of the 24 skills and shelve the complete set in the museum.

goals.title: Build a village
goals.description: Every survivor builds their own home in the same area, until it grows into a small village.
